changes.en: The shared catalog now supports 32 common currencies, including EUR, GBP, JPY, SGD, AUD and CAD, across accounts, transactions, reports, investments, valuations and template imports.

changes.zh: 货币与汇率页面可修改默认货币，应用于新账户、记账和主要报表的初始选择，首页按默认货币统计并显示对应货币标记；不会换算或改写已有账务。
changes.en: Change the default currency in Currency settings for new accounts, entry and main report defaults. Dashboard totals use the selected default currency with matching labels; existing ledger values remain unchanged.

changes.zh: 联网获取 Frankfurter 最新参考汇率，显示来源、报价日期与获取时间，支持换算、刷新和手动保存历史估值；参考价非实时成交价，周末或假日可能沿用上一交易日。
changes.en: Fetch the latest Frankfurter reference quotes with source, quote date and fetch time, conversion, refresh and explicit saving for historical valuation. Reference rates are not live execution prices and may use the prior business day.

changes.zh: 记账可选择币种并匹配对应资金账户，跨币种转账可填入最新参考汇率并核对实际金额；统一换算的四舍五入规则，校验币种与账户一致。
changes.en: Choose an entry currency and matching account, and fill cross-currency transfer rates from online reference quotes before reviewing actual amounts. Conversion rounding and account-currency validation are consistent.

title.zh: 工资条与薪酬方案支持删除
title.en: Delete payslips and compensation plan versions

changes.zh: 工资条列表、手机卡片和详情新增删除入口与二次确认，可删除工资条及其构成、附件和更正历史；删除后刷新薪酬统计。原收入交易与账户余额保留。
changes.en: Payslip lists, mobile cards and details now offer confirmed deletion of payslips, items, attachments and revision history, with refreshed payroll statistics. Income transactions and account balances are retained.

changes.zh: 薪酬方案支持按版本删除；有工资条引用的方案、有关联到账或缴费记录的工资条会提示先解除引用，并校验用户归属与数据版本。
changes.en: Compensation plans can be deleted per version. Referenced plans and payslips linked to receipts or contributions require unlinking first, with ownership and version checks.

title.zh: 五类模板导入
title.en: template imports

changes.zh: 商户、项目、投资资产、商品价格及借入与借出新增 CSV 模板下载、文件校验、逐行预览与确认导入，展示各行处理结果。
changes.en: CSV templates, validation, row previews, confirmation and per-row results for merchants, projects, investment assets, product prices and loans.

changes.zh: 投资资产导入仅登记资产资料；商品价格样本不产生支出；借贷确认后沿用现有记账规则影响资金账户余额。
changes.en: Asset imports register asset details only; product price samples create no expenses. Confirmed loans use existing accounting rules and affect account balances.

title.zh: 邀请准入
title.en: invitation access

changes.zh: 关闭公开注册，新增管理员生成、限时、单次使用、可绑定邮箱及撤销的邀请码；后端独立校验并防止并发重复兑换。已有用户继续正常登录。
changes.en: Public signup is closed. Administrators can issue expiring, single-use invitations with optional email binding and revocation. Server-side checks prevent concurrent reuse; existing users retain normal login.

changes.zh: 登录页提供邀请码激活入口与状态提示，后台新增邀请码管理；统一产品版本、渠道和发布号，前后端共用版本公告源。
changes.en: Invitation activation and status feedback on the login flow, administrator invitation management, and shared frontend/backend product, channel and release metadata.

title.zh: AI 财务洞察与每日收支
title.en: AI financial insights and daily totals

changes.zh: 首页收支趋势下方新增 AI 财务洞察，复用现有 DeepSeek 及分项授权，自动分析消费异常、支出增长、高额消费和节省空间，支持查看工具依据及一键追问 Copilot。
changes.en: Dashboard AI insights reuse existing DeepSeek and data permissions to analyze unusual spending, expense growth, large purchases and savings, with tool evidence and Copilot follow-up.

changes.zh: 交易日历新增每日总收入、总支出及当日完整金额，支持选择统计币种，复用报表的退款、手续费及转账统计规则。
changes.en: The transaction calendar now shows daily income and expenses with full selected-day totals and a currency selector, using existing report rules for refunds, fees and transfers.

title.zh: 首页交易日历与卡片对齐
title.en: Dashboard transaction calendar and aligned cards

changes.zh: 首页新增跟随所选月份的交易日历，显示每日笔数，点击日期可查看当天交易并打开详情。
changes.en: A dashboard transaction calendar follows the selected month, shows daily counts and opens daily transactions and their details.

changes.zh: 桌面端最近交易与我的账户改为同一行，卡片底部对齐；手机端保持上下排列。
changes.en: Recent transactions and My accounts now share a desktop row with aligned card bottoms, while remaining stacked on mobile.

title.zh: 手机端商户下拉选择
title.en: Mobile merchant dropdown

changes.zh: 手机记账的商户、对象及付款方改用与分类一致的可搜索下拉框，支持选择已有商户、输入新名称和清空；保留商户推荐分类。
changes.en: Mobile merchant, counterparty and payer fields now use the same searchable dropdown as categories, with existing merchants, new names, clearing and category recommendations.

title.zh: 薪酬与社保中心
title.en: Payroll & Social Benefits

changes.zh: 升级薪酬与社保中心，集中管理多家就业单位、并行工作经历、薪酬方案与历史版本，以及工资结构、奖金和补贴。
changes.en: A dedicated center manages multiple employers, concurrent employment, versioned compensation plans, pay structure, bonuses and allowances.

changes.zh: 工资条支持生成、复制、核对确认、更正留痕、附件及 PDF 打印导出；可分批关联既有银行收入，不重复记账。
changes.en: Generate, copy, review and confirm payslips, retain correction history, attach files and print to PDF. Link existing bank income in installments without posting it again.

changes.zh: 社保与公积金分别跟踪个人、单位、预计和实际缴费，支持地方政策版本、差额核对、余额记录、提取、结息和转移。
changes.en: Track personal and employer social insurance and housing fund contributions, expected versus actual amounts, local policy versions, differences, reported balances, withdrawals, interest and transfers.

changes.zh: 新增版本化个税规则、专项附加扣除自查、累计预扣及年终奖情景，并可比较调薪与参保地区政策变化；模拟不替代申报。
changes.en: Versioned income-tax rules, reviewed additional deductions, cumulative withholding and bonus scenarios, with pay-change and insurance-city comparisons. Simulations do not replace tax filing.

changes.zh: 支持 Excel（XLSX）、CSV、图片和批量手工工资条导入；图片使用浏览器本地 OCR，经映射、校验和确认后保存草稿。
changes.en: Import Excel (XLSX), CSV, images or manual batches. Browser-local OCR feeds field mapping, validation and review before drafts are saved.

changes.zh: 新增薪酬日历、按归属月或发薪月统计、年度报告和中英文深浅主题界面；AI 薪酬助手复用现有 DeepSeek 连接及薪酬授权。
changes.en: Payroll calendar, earning-month or pay-date reporting, annual reports and bilingual light/dark interfaces. The AI payroll assistant reuses existing DeepSeek configuration and payroll consent.

title.zh: 后台管理与帮助反馈
title.en: Administration, help and feedback

changes.zh: 新增后台概览、用户查询、会话撤销和后台操作记录，后台功能仅管理员可访问。
changes.en: Administrator-only overview, user search, session revocation and administration activity log.

changes.zh: 新增帮助与反馈入口，可搜索常见使用说明、提交问题或建议，并查看处理状态与管理员回复。
changes.en: Search help articles, submit questions or suggestions, and track progress and administrator replies.

changes.zh: 管理员可筛选、回复和处理反馈；反馈按用户隔离，并提供提交频率限制与处理版本检查。
changes.en: Administrators can filter, reply to and resolve feedback, with user isolation, submission limits and concurrency checks.

title.zh: 充值、提现与转账导入
title.en: Top-ups, withdrawals and transfer imports

changes.zh: 记账新增独立的充值、提现入口；交易列表、详情和首页显示对应用途，后台仍按转账核算。
changes.en: Separate top-up and withdrawal entries, with purpose labels in transactions, details and the dashboard. Both use transfer accounting.

changes.zh: 新增转账 CSV 模板，支持逐行匹配转出与转入账户，以及充值、提现、手续费和跨币种转账导入。
changes.en: A transfer CSV template supports per-row source and destination accounts, top-ups, withdrawals, fees and foreign-currency transfers.

changes.zh: 导入预览可核对账户流向并修改账户、用途及手续费；校验无效账户、重复流水和金额汇率，转账本金不计收支。
changes.en: Preview account flows and edit accounts, purposes and fees. Validation checks accounts, duplicate references, amounts and exchange rates; transfer principal is excluded from income and expenses.

changes.zh: 手机记账类型改为下拉选择，交易可单独筛选充值、提现；导出保留转账用途、转入账户、手续费和汇率。
changes.en: Mobile entry types use a dropdown. Filter top-ups and withdrawals separately; exports include purpose, destination, fees and exchange rates.

title.zh: 版本更新中心
title.en: Release center

changes.zh: 新增版本更新页面，集中公示新功能、体验优化和问题修复。
changes.en: A dedicated page for new features, improvements and fixes.

changes.zh: 可搜索历史更新，查看当前版本，并检查、刷新到新版本。
changes.en: Search past updates, view your current version, and check for and apply updates.

changes.zh: 设置、功能导航和用户菜单均可进入版本更新页面。
changes.en: Open release notes from Settings, navigation or your user menu.

title.zh: 支出新增商品名
title.en: Product names for expenses

changes.zh: 支出记账新增独立的商品名选填项，支持编辑、清空和连续记账。
changes.en: An optional product name for expenses, including editing, clearing and consecutive entries.

changes.zh: 交易详情、电脑列表和手机卡片显示商品名，支持关键词搜索及导出。
changes.en: Product names appear in details and transaction lists, and are included in search and exports.

title.zh: AI 完整分析与建议
title.en: Complete AI analysis and advice

changes.zh: 取消聊天与 Agent 回答的自动摘要替换，直接显示 AI 分析和建议。
changes.en: Chat and Agent answers retain their analysis and advice instead of being replaced by a summary.

changes.zh: 月度收支查询先读取已授权数据，再交给 AI 分析；权威查询数据继续保留。
changes.en: Monthly summaries retrieve authorized ledger data before AI analysis, with source results retained.

title.zh: 会话历史布局修复
title.en: Conversation history layout fixes

changes.zh: 长标题最多显示两行，删除按钮保持在面板内，修复横向溢出。
changes.en: Long titles wrap to two lines and delete buttons stay inside the panel.

changes.zh: 会话标题显示实际问题，不再使用页面上下文说明；保留自定义名称。
changes.en: Conversation titles show the actual question rather than page context, while preserving custom names.

title.zh: 月度收支查询改进
title.en: Monthly income and expense queries

changes.zh: 改进日期、编号、金额格式和百分比的校验，减少不必要的误判。
changes.en: Improved handling of dates, list numbering, amount formats and percentages.

changes.zh: 修复月度查询遗漏工具调用及已查询数据被误标为无依据的问题。
changes.en: Fixed missing monthly tool queries and incorrect missing-evidence labels.

title.zh: 自主财务 Agent
title.en: Autonomous finance Agent

changes.zh: 支持跨模块分析、多轮工具调用、报告、记忆和定时工作流。
changes.en: Cross-module analysis, multiple tool rounds, reports, memory and scheduled workflows.

changes.zh: 新增建议、确认执行和授权自动执行模式，高风险操作独立授权。
changes.en: Suggestion, confirmation and scoped automatic modes, with separate high-risk authorization.

changes.zh: 提供模型、资源预算、数据范围、操作日志和紧急停止设置。
changes.en: Settings for models, resource budgets, data scope, operation logs and emergency stop.

title.zh: 手机端选择与筛选体验
title.en: Mobile selection and filters

changes.zh: 优化手机端日期时间、分类、账户等选择控件和筛选布局。
changes.en: Improved mobile date, time, category and account selectors and filter layouts.

changes.zh: 改进小屏操作区域、弹层定位与下拉选项展示。
changes.en: Better touch controls, popup placement and dropdown visibility on small screens.

title.zh: 财务与权限问题修复
title.en: Finance and authorization fixes

changes.zh: 修复项目审查发现的财务处理、前端交互和 AI 授权问题。
changes.en: Fixed finance, interface and AI authorization issues identified during project review.

changes.zh: 加强运行账号权限、备份验证及发布检查。
changes.en: Strengthened runtime permissions, backup verification and release checks.

changes.zh: 修复 AI 草稿批量确认/删除被拦截、投资撤销持仓校验、重复导出旧文件及导出笔数显示。
changes.en: Fixed blocked AI draft bulk confirmation/deletion, investment reversal holding checks, stale export reuse and exported row counts.

changes.zh: 修复电子钱包漏算流动资金、内部转账手续费漏计承诺、跨币种收款活动遗漏，以及 AI 交易查询结束日边界。
changes.en: Fixed wallet liquidity classification, transfer-fee commitments, missing cross-currency receipt activity and AI query end-date boundaries.

changes.zh: 手机翻页保留排序和筛选，AI 草稿及历史标题遵从隐私隐藏；修复订阅未来价格与拆分模板冲突、工具分页截断提示及登录限流。
changes.en: Mobile pagination retains ordering and filters, AI drafts/history titles respect privacy, and subscription future-price split conflicts, tool pagination indicators and login rate limits are corrected.

changes.zh: 加强运行权限、依赖安全与发布恢复：备份失败阻止轮转，发布先校验备份、保留旧资源并支持代码回退；公开公告不包含配置与凭据。
changes.en: Strengthened runtime permissions, dependency security and deployment recovery: failed backups block rotation; releases verify and back up first, retain old assets and support code rollback. Public notes omit configuration and credentials.

title.zh: 首页与整体界面更新
title.en: Dashboard and interface redesign

changes.zh: 重新设计首页仪表盘、导航和主要功能页面，改善信息层级。
changes.en: Redesigned the dashboard, navigation and main pages for clearer information.

changes.zh: 完善手机、平板与桌面布局，并保留深色和中英文界面。
changes.en: Improved phone, tablet and desktop layouts with dark mode and Chinese/English support.

changes.zh: AI 智能中心增加总览、Copilot、智能记账、分析、预测、预算、资产负债、风险、订阅、目标、报告、自动化、记忆与设置十四个入口，复用原有业务模块。
changes.en: The AI center adds fourteen entries for overview, Copilot, bookkeeping, analysis, forecasts, budgets, assets/debt, risk, subscriptions, goals, reports, automation, memory and settings, reusing existing modules.

changes.zh: AI 总览展示账本摘要、提醒、洞察、未来现金流和最近报告，打开总览不自动调用模型；AI 报告保留来源依据，支持恢复会话与历史管理。
changes.en: AI overview shows ledger summaries, reminders, insights, forecast and recent reports without automatically calling the model. AI reports retain evidence and support conversation restoration and history management.

changes.zh: 全局 Copilot 位于已登录页面顶部，携带允许的页面、期间、币种及账户上下文；面板显示查询范围，切换页面取消未完成对话，退出登录清理上下文。
changes.en: Global Copilot appears in authenticated toolbars with allowed page, period, currency and account context, displays scope, cancels unfinished chat on navigation and clears context on logout.

changes.zh: 云端主账本、登录与 AI 运行问题修复，默认标签和商品价格目录补齐；目录样本不产生正式消费，原账本及授权边界保留。
changes.en: Fixed cloud-ledger, login and AI runtime issues and added default tag/product-price directories. Reference price samples create no expenses; existing ledgers and consent boundaries are preserved.

title.zh: AI 核心升级阶段
title.en: AI core upgrade stage

changes.zh: 归档 Phase 0 审计与 Phase 1 AI 核心交付。审计、迁移计划与已交付能力分别按原文记录。
changes.en: Archived Phase 0 audit and Phase 1 AI core delivery. Audits, migration plans and delivered capabilities retain their original status.

changes.zh: AI 查询绑定当前用户、个人账本及明确账户集合，不支持筛选的工具拒绝扩大查询；提供模型配置、资源预算、上下文和并发限制。
changes.en: AI queries bind to the current user, ledger and explicit accounts; tools reject unsupported filters instead of broadening scope. Model configuration, budgets, context and concurrency limits are available.

changes.zh: 会话历史由用户主动开启，支持分页搜索、重命名、归档删除、反馈复制、重试停止和依据查看；保存期限及清理策略明确，历史金额不充当当前事实。
changes.en: Opt-in conversation history supports paging, search, rename, archive/delete, feedback, copy, retry, stop and evidence, with retention rules; historical amounts are not reused as current facts.

changes.zh: 持久交易草稿支持逐条验证、批量解析预览、编辑、删除和确认；三级分类完整路径与规则优先级匹配，冲突留待人工处理，不静默新增目录或过账。
changes.en: Persistent transaction drafts support row validation, batch parsing previews, editing, deletion and confirmation, with full category paths and rule priorities; conflicts need review and never silently create directories or post entries.

changes.zh: 完善中英界面、流式待核验状态、手机布局、基础脱敏与请求/工具/草稿关联审计；授权变更阻止后续模型调用。
changes.en: Improved bilingual UI, provisional streaming states, mobile layout, basic redaction and linked request/tool/draft auditing; consent changes block subsequent model calls.

title.zh: AI 首批接入与目录维护
title.en: Initial AI integration and directory maintenance

changes.zh: 依据阶段 AI 和目录交付记录归档首批 AI 接入、目录扩充及批量删除说明，保留当时的授权和验证边界。
changes.en: Archived initial AI integration, directory expansion and batch deletion records, retaining their original authorization and validation limits.

changes.zh: 账户管理升级：账户档案、银行卡信息、排序、停用归档、受保护删除、关联活动及收支统计，增加账户健康检查；复用既有余额核算。
changes.en: Account management upgrade: profiles, bank-card details, ordering, deactivation, archiving, protected deletion, linked activity and statistics, plus health checks using existing balance accounting.

changes.zh: 个人信息中心：资料、头像、注册与修改密码、会话撤销、语言及偏好；新用户只初始化分类规则，不创建虚假账户或资金。
changes.en: Personal profiles: details, avatars, registration, password changes, session revocation, language and preferences. New users receive category/rule defaults without fictitious accounts or funds.

changes.zh: 目录扩充与操作：新增商户及标签基础目录，改善目录搜索与分页，增加目录和交易批量删除，引用保护与用户隔离继续生效。
changes.en: Directory work expanded merchant/tag defaults, improved search and pagination, and added directory/transaction bulk deletion with reference protection and user isolation.

changes.zh: 三级分类与详情：层级展开、创建排序、停用恢复及受保护删除；完整路径选择，父级笔数去重、退款净额、优惠分摊、趋势与预算执行，统计按币种隔离。
changes.en: Three-level categories: expansion, creation, ordering, status and protected deletion, full-path selection, deduplicated parent counts, refund net amounts, allocated discounts, trends and budgets, isolated by currency.

changes.zh: DeepSeek 首批接入：流式对话、只读财务工具、隐私授权、自然语言草稿、Token/费用统计及审计；密钥留在服务端，确认前不产生交易。
changes.en: Initial DeepSeek integration: streamed chat, read-only financial tools, privacy consent, natural-language drafts, token/cost tracking and audit. Keys stay server-side and drafts do not post before confirmation.

changes.zh: 本地运行修复：补齐 AI 页面接口、数据库及快速进入检查，修复项目检查发现的问题；保留已有账本与桌面启动方式。
changes.en: Local runtime fixes restored missing AI endpoints and database/quick-start checks, addressing reviewed issues while retaining the ledger and desktop entry points.

title.zh: 维护与验收文档归档
title.en: Maintenance and validation archive

changes.zh: 归档长期维护、核算、备份恢复与本机验收资料；本机验收不等同于生产切换。
changes.en: Archived maintenance, accounting, backup, recovery and local validation documents. Local validation does not imply a production rollout.

changes.zh: F 投资与资产：投资资产、交易、持仓、成本收益、估值与撤销；存款及实物档案、价格记录和到期事项，按业务规则避免本金与收益重复统计。
changes.en: F investments and assets: asset records, trades, holdings, costs, returns, valuations and reversals; deposits, physical assets, prices and maturity tracking avoid double-counting principal and returns.

changes.zh: 多币种估值使用已登记、截至所选日期的直接汇率；保留来源与日期，缺失汇率或价格明确显示覆盖不足，不虚构折算金额。
changes.en: Currency valuations use recorded direct rates effective by the selected date, retaining sources and dates and marking incomplete coverage when rates or prices are missing.

changes.zh: 优惠与权益：原价、运费、优惠明细、平台补贴与实付关系；券及非现金权益档案、有效期、使用/返还记录、临期提示。
changes.en: Promotions and benefits: list prices, shipping, discounts, subsidies and paid totals, plus voucher and non-cash benefit records, expiry, usage, returns and expiry reminders.

changes.zh: 返现及优惠分析：待返现、到账、撤销、追回与历史，关联原消费，区分价格调整退款与独立奖励；按月、平台、商户和类型分析，积分不伪装现金。
changes.en: Cashback and promotion analysis: pending receipts, settlement, reversal, recovery and history linked to original expenses, distinguishing price-adjustment refunds from rewards with monthly/platform/merchant/type analysis; points are not represented as cash.

changes.zh: G1—G3 资金状态：冻结、在途、确认及部分释放/结算；预付款、押金的消费退款核销与更正；货币启停排序及历史引用保护。
changes.en: G1–G3 fund states: frozen and in-transit funds, confirmation, partial release and settlement; prepayment/deposit consumption, refunds, write-offs and corrections; currency status, ordering and historical references.

changes.zh: G4—G5 工资与缴费首版：工资构成、所属期、分次关联到账，社保与公积金缴费、工资扣款关联和余额来源；后续薪酬中心升级另列。
changes.en: G4–G5 initial payroll and contributions: pay components, earning periods, installment receipt links, social insurance and housing contributions, deduction links and balance sources; later payroll-center upgrades are listed separately.

changes.zh: G6 付款授权：实际扣款账户、授权人/消费人、有效期、状态与月限额；账本外第三方付款仅记录事实，不伪造资金分录。
changes.en: G6 payment authorizations: payer accounts, authorized users and spenders, validity, status and monthly limits. External third-party payments record facts without inventing ledger entries.

changes.zh: G7 生活成本：商品、品牌、规格、商户、标价与到手价、单位及固定篮子，展示同比环比、异常样本和覆盖缺口；独立价格样本不产生消费。
changes.en: G7 living costs: products, brands, specifications, merchants, list/paid prices, units and fixed baskets, with year/month comparisons, outliers and coverage gaps; price samples create no expenses.

changes.zh: G8 历史上的今日：按北京时间日期、年份、分类和币种回看历史交易、主要分类与最大消费，并可跳转原记录。
changes.en: G8 on this day: revisit historical transactions, categories and largest expenses by Shanghai date, year, category and currency, with links to original records.

changes.zh: G9 代买代付：本人费用与应收拆分、分次归还、转赠/核销/退货、交付记录、家庭分摊、待购及取消，复用既有借贷和交易核算。
changes.en: G9 advances and proxy purchases: personal-expense/receivable splits, repayments, gifting, write-off, returns, delivery history, household allocations and pending/cancelled purchases reuse existing accounting.

changes.zh: 全站 UI/UX 与长期维护：页面信息层级、统一布局、手机适配、隐私模式、核算及操作手册、备份恢复、排障和更新回滚说明；本机验证与正式上线状态分别记录。
changes.en: UI/UX and maintenance: clearer information hierarchy, shared layouts, mobile support, privacy mode, accounting/user manuals, backup, recovery, troubleshooting and rollback documentation, distinguishing local validation from production rollout.

title.zh: 真实后端与基础保障阶段
title.en: Backend and foundation stage

changes.zh: 按阶段 A 至 G 文档追溯真实后端、备份恢复、报表、导入与外部事实能力；各批次完成及未完成状态保留，不将审计或计划视为已上线功能。
changes.en: Stages A through G document the backend, backup and recovery, reports, imports and external facts. Original completion limits remain; audits and plans are not treated as shipped features.

changes.zh: 真实后端：接入认证、个人账本隔离、账户及交易接口、精确金额核算与并发幂等保护，前端切换真实 API。
changes.en: Backend foundation connected authentication, isolated personal ledgers, account and transaction APIs, exact financial calculations, version and idempotency safeguards, and real frontend API integration.

changes.zh: A1：完整备份、校验与隔离恢复流程，包含业务表、附件和账户余额核对；恢复演练不覆盖正式账本。
changes.en: A1: full backup, verification and isolated recovery, checking business tables, attachments and account balances without overwriting the live ledger.

changes.zh: A2：跨刷新提交结果查询、使用原请求编号确认重试、同事务操作审计，以及交易详情的分页操作历史与隐私隐藏。
changes.en: A2: recover submissions after refresh, query outcomes and retry with the original operation key, with transactional audit and paginated privacy-aware transaction history.

changes.zh: A3.1—A3.2：修复导入状态、手续费统计开关与历史期末摘要；分类编辑排序及交易恢复增加版本保护，分类删除提供引用预览并保护历史关联。
changes.en: A3.1–A3.2: fixed import status, fee statistics and historical closing summaries; added version protection for category edits, ordering and transaction restoration, plus reference previews and protected category deletion.

changes.zh: A3.3：导入重新检查预览、过账前整批校验、失败恢复、逐行结果和处理历史；区分确定重复与疑似重复，保留人工处理与来源身份信息。
changes.en: A3.3: import rechecks, whole-batch validation before posting, failure recovery, row results and processing history, distinguishing definite and suspected duplicates with manual review and source identity.

changes.zh: A3.4：修复父子预算互斥、历史预算兼容、预算编辑状态及信用卡账单时间边界，不静默删除旧额度或修改历史交易。
changes.en: A3.4: corrected overlapping parent/child budgets, legacy budget compatibility, editing state and credit-card date boundaries without silently deleting old allocations or changing historical transactions.

changes.zh: A3.5—A3.9：建立隔离性能基线，优化长周期报表、交易搜索、操作成功反馈及首页/目录聚合；修复大批量导入、失败恢复与并发检查中发现的问题，不承诺未经验证的规模性能。
changes.en: A3.5–A3.9: established an isolated performance baseline, improved long-period reports, search, success feedback and dashboard/directory aggregation, and fixed batch import and recovery issues without claiming unverified scale performance.

changes.zh: B1—B2 周期交易：收入、支出、转账及多种重复周期，独立时区、月底策略、启停与结束；待确认实例提供快照、影响预览、跳过、重试、确认过账及历史，默认不自动记账。
changes.en: B1–B2 recurring transactions: income, expenses, transfers, repeat schedules, time zones, month-end policies and lifecycle states, with snapshots, impact previews, skipping, retries and confirmed posting; automatic posting is not enabled by default.

changes.zh: B3—B5 订阅与自动分类：服务商、续费、到期与价格历史；按商户、备注、金额、账户等条件生成建议，支持优先级、预览冲突、人工确认和执行日志。
changes.en: B3–B5 subscriptions and classification: providers, renewals, expiry and price history; merchant, note, amount and account rules support priorities, conflict previews, human approval and execution logs.

changes.zh: B6—B7 财务日历与提醒：月/周/列表视图整合周期、订阅及信用卡实际剩余应还，首页显示待确认、逾期、失败与临期事项。
changes.en: B6–B7 calendar and reminders: month, week and list views combine recurring items, subscriptions and actual outstanding card amounts, with pending, overdue, failed and upcoming dashboard reminders.

changes.zh: C1 保存视图：待整理交易入口、筛选与排序收藏、显示字段选择，以及 Windows 一键启动停止；浏览器收藏按用户隔离，不宣称跨设备同步。
changes.en: C1 saved views: transaction review, saved filters and ordering, selectable columns and Windows startup/stop tools. Browser favorites are user-isolated and do not imply cross-device sync.

changes.zh: C2 批量整理：跨页选择、手机卡片多选、分类/商户/标签/项目/备注批量修改，先预览再按版本整批提交；问题支持处理、忽略、延后、重开及历史。
changes.en: C2 batch review: selection across pages and mobile cards, bulk category, merchant, tag, project and note changes with version-bound previews and atomic confirmation; review issues support resolution, ignoring, deferral, reopening and history.

changes.zh: D1—D2 年度预算：年度计划、十二个月分配、分类额度、复制和差异确认；增加结转预览、调整历史、预警、模板及历史建议。
changes.en: D1–D2 annual budgets: yearly plans, twelve-month allocations, category limits, copying and difference confirmation, plus carryover previews, adjustment history, alerts, templates and historical suggestions.

changes.zh: D3—D4 目标与指标：分币种储蓄目标、资金预留/释放/目标间转移、进度历史，必要支出分类、应急储备与储蓄率分析。
changes.en: D3–D4 goals and indicators: currency-specific saving goals, allocation, release and transfers between goals, history, essential-expense classification, emergency reserve and savings-rate analysis.

changes.zh: D5 现金流：手动计划、周期与订阅、信用卡账单统一生成预测、每日余额、事件及资金缺口，提供期间、账户、币种和情景筛选；预测不计入实际余额。
changes.en: D5 cash flow: combine manual plans, recurring items, subscriptions and card statements into forecasts, daily balances, events and gaps with period, account, currency and scenario filters; forecasts never change actual balances.

changes.zh: E1—E3 分析：月报年报、期间比较、分类差额、商户排行、收入来源、收支结构、固定/变动/未知属性、健康概览和资产负债归因；历史期初缺失时明确推算及未解释差额。
changes.en: E1–E3 analysis: monthly and annual reviews, period comparisons, category differences, merchant rankings, income sources, fixed/variable/unknown structure, health overview and net-worth attribution, labeling estimates and unexplained differences.

changes.zh: E4—E5 债务计划：信用卡消费及既有债务的分期计划、精确期表、多种本金/费用模式、实际核对、历史与结清预览；不替代银行账单或合同。
changes.en: E4–E5 debt planning: installment plans for card spending and existing debts, exact schedules, principal and fee modes, reconciliation, history and settlement previews; plans do not replace bank statements or contracts.

changes.zh: E6—E7 情景与压力：复用现金流预测比较情景，提供债务压力、计划与实际核对及指标说明；原报告列出的部分实现和未完成事项继续保留。
changes.en: E6–E7 scenarios and pressure: reuse cash-flow forecasts for scenario comparison, debt-pressure analysis, planned/actual reconciliation and metric explanations, retaining documented partial and incomplete scope.

title.zh: 首个测试版：前端基础与日常记账
title.en: First beta: frontend and daily bookkeeping

changes.zh: 前端阶段文档记录基础记账、账户、退款、信用卡、预算、目录、导入与对账；早期模拟接口及待联调限制以原报告为准。
changes.en: Frontend stage records cover bookkeeping, accounts, refunds, credit cards, budgets, directories, imports and reconciliation. Original mock API and integration limitations remain applicable.

changes.zh: 基础记账与账户：首页摘要、收支趋势、最近交易、账户余额、收入/支出/转账、交易详情、筛选、分页、编辑、软删除与恢复。
changes.en: Core frontend: dashboard summaries, trends, recent transactions, account balances, income, expenses, transfers, details, filters, pagination, editing, soft deletion and restoration.

changes.zh: 第二阶段：退款额度与分类核对、信用卡账单及还款、消费分类拆分、预算编辑与并发提示、分币种收支统计及分类下钻。
changes.en: Stage two: refund limits and categories, credit-card statements and repayment, expense splits, budget editing with conflict feedback, currency-specific statistics and category drill-down.

changes.zh: 第三阶段：借入借出、归还与偿还、报销提交与到账、项目分析、商户推荐分类、标签关联和模板预填；模板须经确认才记账。
changes.en: Stage three: borrowing, lending, settlement, reimbursement receipts, project analysis, merchant category suggestions, tags and template prefilling, with confirmation before posting.

changes.zh: 第四阶段：导入映射、重复及异常预览、人工确认，对账、附件、导出、账户趋势、高级统计与生产 PWA；离线缓存不包含 API 财务响应。
changes.en: Stage four: import mapping, duplicate and invalid-row previews, confirmation, reconciliation, attachments, exports, account trends, advanced statistics and production PWA without caching financial API responses.

changes.zh: 最终阶段补齐认证会话、错误反馈、加载与空状态、手机导航、中英文、深浅主题与隐藏金额；当时模拟接口及真实后端待联调限制保留。
changes.en: Final frontend work added sessions, error feedback, loading and empty states, mobile navigation, bilingual themes and privacy mode. Original mock API and pending backend integration limits are retained.

title.zh: 数据库设计基线
title.en: Database design baseline

changes.zh: 整理原始数据库表结构与验证说明；这是追溯基线，不代表应用正式发布。
changes.en: Original database schema and validation documentation; an archival baseline, not a production release.

changes.zh: 统一账户、财务事件与资金分录模型，记录收入、支出、转账、退款、期初余额、多币种与精确金额；保留原始表结构、索引及验证文档。
changes.en: Documented a shared model for accounts, financial events and entries, covering income, expenses, transfers, refunds, opening balances, currencies and exact amounts, with schema, indexes and validation records.
